text: サファリ　ゾーンは　いりぐち　ふきんは　どうぶつえんで　おくに　いくと　ポケモンが　とりほうだいの　サファリ　ゲームじゃ

structure.jp: サファリ　ゾーンは
いりぐち　ふきんは　どうぶつえんで
structure.en: the area near the entrance is a zoo, and

structure.jp: ポケモンが　とりほうだいの　サファリ　ゲームじゃ
structure.en: it is the Safari Game where you can catch all the Pokémon you like

patterns.name: 〜と (if/when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says that whenever this happens, the next thing follows. おくに　いくと = 'when you go further in'.

patterns.name: 〜で (linking)
patterns.explanation: で here is だ 'is' in its joining form, so the sentence carries on with 'and'. どうぶつえんで = 'is a zoo, and'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.span: サファリ　ゲームじゃ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is how old men in stories say だ 'is'. サファリ　ゲームじゃ = 'it is the Safari Game'.
